summary.en-US: Professor ratings, schedule insights, and class availability notifications for USC students.

description.en-US:
USC Schedule Helper improves the USC class search and Web Registration experience. It adds professor ratings to class results, highlights schedule conflicts, shows unit totals, exports registered classes to an .ics calendar, and lets students request class availability notifications. Calendar export uses USC's published term and session dates, skips holidays and session breaks, and opens USC's official exporter if the required data cannot be validated.

Email notifications are free. Optional SMS notifications cost $1 per section per semester.

The extension runs on classes.usc.edu and webreg.usc.edu. Calendar files are generated locally, with public date and holiday lookups from classes.usc.edu and www.usc.edu that omit sign-in credentials. Catalog requests contain course, term, or session identifiers. Notification requests send the email address, optional phone number, and selected class details that the user submits to usc.jonlu.ca. See the privacy policy at https://usc.jonlu.ca/privacy.

release_notes.en-US: Added Export as .ics beside Export to PDF in Web Registration. Calendar export now uses USC's published term and session dates across years, excludes holidays and session breaks, preserves multiple meeting times and locations, and skips classes with TBA times. If required data cannot be validated, USC's official calendar exporter opens instead. Added host permissions for https://classes.usc.edu/* and https://www.usc.edu/* to retrieve public calendar metadata without sign-in credentials.

version.approval_notes: Build instructions and calendar export test steps are in SOURCE_CODE_REVIEW.md in the uploaded source archive. No API keys or .env files are required. Public pages under https://classes.usc.edu/term/ exercise ratings and notification UI. Calendar export requires a USC-authenticated Web Registration session and registered classes. The extension reads that schedule from WebReg and generates the .ics file locally. Host permissions are exactly https://classes.usc.edu/* and https://www.usc.edu/*; public course/session and academic-calendar lookups omit credentials and use course, term, or session identifiers. The background accepts calendar requests only from https://webreg.usc.edu. Invalid or unavailable calendar data sends the user to https://my.usc.edu/ical/?term=... without downloading a partial calendar. Email notifications are free; optional SMS notifications cost $1 per section per semester. A user-entered email address, optional phone number, and selected class department/section/semester are sent to https://usc.jonlu.ca only after the user clicks Submit in the notification form.
